cells.user: Gradient descent ante enti? Simple ga cheppandi.

bare.response:
Gradient descent ante machine learning model tana tappulanu thagginchukune oka paddhati.

Oka konda meeda kallu mooskoni nilabadi, lopali lotha ku cheralani anukondi. Meeru kaalitho slope ye vaipu thaggutundo chusi, aa vaipu chinna adugu vestaru. Idi malli malli chestaru.

Model lo:
- "Konda" = loss (error)
- "Slope" = gradient
- "Adugu size" = learning rate

Pratee step lo model tana weights ni konchem marchi, error thagginchi, chivariki thakkuva error unde chota cheruthundi.

profile.response:
Bro, gradient descent ante oka kondapai nundi kindaki digadam laga anukో. Kallu mooskuni unnav, kani ekkada slope ekkuva untundo adi telustundi, aa vaipu chinna steps veestav. Ila repeat chesthe lowest point (minimum) ki chereestav.

ML lo aa "kinda" ante error/loss. Model weights ni konchem konchem adjust chesthu loss taggistharu. Step size ni learning rate antaru. Chala pedda aite minimum miss avuthav, chala chinna aite time pattutundi.

cells.user: Gradient descent ante enti? Simple ga cheppandi.

bare.response:
Gradient descent ante machine learning model tana tappulanu thagginchukune oka paddhati.

Oka konda meeda kallu mooskoni nilabadi, lopali lotha ku cheralani anukondi. Meeru kaalitho slope ye vaipu thaggutundo chusi, aa vaipu chinna adugu vestaru. Idi malli malli chestaru.

Model lo:
- "Konda" = loss (error)
- "Slope" = gradient
- "Adugu size" = learning rate

Pratee step lo model tana weights ni konchem marchi, error thagginchi, chivariki thakkuva error unde chota cheruthundi.

profile.response:
Gradient descent oka optimization method. Model lo loss function ni minimize cheyadaniki use chestaru.

Idea: oka kondapai nundi lowest point ki dagadam laga anukondi. Prathi step lo current point daggara slope (gradient) chusi, daniki opposite direction lo chinna step veyali. Aa step size ni learning rate antaru.

Update rule: w = w - lr * ∇L(w)

Idi repeat chesthe loss taggi, weights optimal ki converge avuthayi. Learning rate ekkuva aite overshoot, takkuva aite slow.

cells.user: Gradient descent kya hota hai? Simple language mein samjhao.

bare.response:
Gradient descent ek tarika hai jisse machine learning model apni galtiyan kam karta hai.

Sochiye aap pahaad par aankhein band karke khade hain aur sabse neeche vaali ghaati tak pahunchna hai. Aap pair se check karte ho ki dhalaan (slope) kis taraf neeche ja rahi hai, aur chhota kadam us taraf lete ho. Ye baar-baar karte ho.

Model mein:
- "Pahaad" = loss (error)
- "Dhalaan" = gradient
- "Kadam ka size" = learning rate

Har step mein model apne weights thode badalta hai taaki error kam ho, aur aakhir mein minimum error ke paas pahunch jaata hai.

profile.response:

Gradient descent bhi yahi karta hai. Machine learning mein model ki "galti" (loss) ko kam karna hota hai. Gradient batata hai ki kis direction mein galti sabse tezi se badh rahi hai, aur hum ulti direction mein chalte hain.
